job.purpose: In-game lag card, step 1, part A of 2: a MEASUREMENT with zero tries. One minute candles of one moneyline market and four low spread strikes for each NBA, NHL and NFL game of a fixed list (closes 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-11). No trade is scored.
job.heldout: none (a measurement of quote timing; no settlement result is read and no rule is scored). The spread markets are also the unread sample of W-SPREAD-CELL1: the reader uses in-play candles only and prints no pre-game price and no outcome.
job.notes: One batched request per game, 3 to 5 tickers, about 4 to 5 hours of 1 minute candles ending at the market's close. The fixed list of 215 games is split into two jobs (A then B) only to stay under the 200 MB a run size cap; the two answers are ONE measurement, read once, and the list is never extended.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
